immediate_success_conditioned.scope: Only commands whose immediate pre-state is officially successful; not the larger after-first-success subset.

trace_associations.scope: Gripper COMMAND delta is change from the previous command in that episode; first command has no delta. Finger-position delta is measured motion in metres. Same-step associations do not establish contact or control causality. No thresholds are chosen from test outcomes.
